chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever digs a grave for a deceased person is like one who has settled him in a suitable house until the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.بَوَّأَهُ: settled him; lodged him in a place
key_terms.بَيْتًا: a house; here, a figurative expression for a resting place
key_terms.حَفَرَ: dug; performed the act of preparing the grave
key_terms.قَبْرًا: a grave; the burial place of the dead
key_terms.مَنْ: whoever; indicating a general ruling or teaching

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for digging a grave for a deceased person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great merit of digging a grave for a deceased believer, portraying it as an act of care and provision that continues until the Day of Resurrection. It emphasizes honoring the dead and serving them through burial as a deed of significant moral and spiritual value.
